summary: APPROVE. The revised specification separates target paths from top-level symbols, distinguishes .ai/policy configuration from src/aiflow/policy.py, and binds the V2 approval and Gate mutations to new detectors that directly exercise the named enforcement points. Stable error precedence, deterministic Windows symlink coverage, the ordinary-pytest versus manifest-runner boundary, REVIEW + V1 self-bootstrap, unchanged live V2 failure semantics, and Chapter 11.2-only state projection are all explicit and implementable.
